subject: riotInterceptor
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: corporate riot-control interceptor with a water cannon and neon light bars.
Style: Cyberpunk 2077.
reasoning:
I'm planning a single static module for an armored wheeled interceptor truck, roughly 5.2m long and 2.3m wide, featuring a roof-mounted water cannon turret, neon light bars, and corporate decals, while keeping the code compact and error-free.

Now I'm sketching out the overall approach: using box geometry helpers and rotation parameters to build parts without needing joints since this is a static model, picking a palette of dark graphite, white corporate panels, yellow and neon cyan/magenta accents, and planning custom paint functions with noise for armor plating and grime effects, before starting on the chassis construction itself.

I'm abandoning the loft-based hull approach as too risky and switching to frustumBox segments instead, building the lower body as a box and starting the nose as a tapered frustum shape.

For the upper cab, I'm figuring out how to construct it as an extruded side profile with a sloped windshield, working through the geometry of its thickness and axis orientation.

Now I'm computing the windshield placement and tilt angle, positioning it as a dark tinted glass plane connecting the cab's front edge to the roofline with the correct outward-facing normal direction.

I'm also setting up the side windows as planes on the cab's side faces, sized and positioned to match where the front slant ends, keeping them vertical since the side profile is flat above that point.

For the rear, I'm placing a horizontal cylindrical water tank behind the cab, sized and positioned to sit above the lower rear body, painted white with stripes. On top of the tank I'm adding a turret mount with a forward-facing cannon barrel as the water cannon assembly.

I'm designing the barrel to arc over the cab roof without clipping, giving it a slight flare toward a nozzle and adding a glowing cyan ring at the tip instead of actual water spray effects. For the wheels, I'm placing four cylinders rotated to align their axis along x at the front and rear corners, with black tires, steel hubs, and a thin glowing cyan torus ring for a neon accent.

I'm working out wheel arch positions and fender flare dimensions so the tires sit just outside the lower body without excessive overlap, adjusting x-offsets and widths until the total vehicle width comes out balanced.

Now I'm adding cyberpunk neon details: a split magenta/cyan roof light bar, a cyan grille strip under the headlights, dual-color side neon stripes along the lower body, and a magenta underglow box beneath the chassis.

I'm also planning a corporate decal for the tank side featuring a "KIRIN SECURITY" hex logo with "RIOT SUPPRESSION UNIT" text and hazard stripes, and working through the geometry so the flat decal sits flush against the curved tank surface without an awkward gap.

I'm reworking the tank into a simpler blocky box shape instead of a cylinder, sizing it so decals mount flat against the sides, then adding details like top ribs, a hatch, and hoses. I'm also positioning the turret and cannon on top of the tank and cab, checking the heights work out so the barrel clears the roof and light bar, and setting up the cannon on a rotating turret base.

Working out barrel and nozzle geometry...

Now I'm planning the front bumper as a dark box with hazard stripes at the vehicle's nose, plus a riot cage grill made of thin bars across the windshield.

For the sides, I'm figuring out armor panels with yellow chevrons, mirrors, and door decals including seam lines, a handle, and a "SEC-07" number plane positioned on the lower body to avoid overlapping the windows, with neon stripe accents placed just below.

Now I'm adding roof details like antenna sticks with glowing magenta tips, a sensor dome, loudspeaker boxes, camera pods, drone detectors, and rear elements like a tail bar, step, and twin exhaust. Then I'm defining the hull paint function, blending a dark base below a certain height into white using mix and noise utilities from the SDK to create a weathered corporate paint scheme.

Now I'm working out panel seam darkening using modulo math on the z-position, and planning textures for logo, hazard stripes, glass, door numbers, windshield, and plates, while estimating around 120 parts total built through helper functions for boxes and other primitives.

I'm defining a glow helper that wraps boxes, then detailing the hazard stripe texture as an SVG diagonal pattern mapped onto a bumper plane, and working through the exact geometry of the nose, lower body, and bumper boxes to get the frustum shape and dimensions right.

Now I'm placing headlight boxes with warm glow at the nose front and a cyan bar between them, then adding the flat hood section with magenta neon strips and planning the windshield plane next.

Working out the windshield position and angle, computing its normal offset so it sits flush against the cab slope, with proper width and height for the glass texture. Now I'm sketching the cab profile extrusion outline to shape the body sides.

Adding more details...

Now I'm designing the side mirrors with rods connecting to the cab and small mirror boxes, plus tank decal planes with faction branding like "NOVACORP" or "RIOT SUPPRESSION UNIT" lettering with cyan/magenta hex logos and yellow accent bars.

Checking the decal orientation so each tank face reads correctly from the viewer's perspective, then adding the rear tank hazard texture, top ribs, filler hatch, and a curved hose sweeping from the tank rear to the turret.

Now I'm positioning the turret housing on top of the tank and laying out the wheel assemblies, with tires, hubs, glowing outer torus accents, and lug nuts arranged in a ring, plus tire tread detailing.

Adding mudflaps, side steps, rear bumper, and glowing red tail lights to the rear of the body...

Checking the upper neon strip placement near y1.12 against wheel geometry — tires span x1.04-1.46 and could poke into the body, but the wheel arch should mask it. I'll keep the lower magenta stripe confined to just the skirt area so it doesn't clash, then move on to detailing the water cannon barrel.

Adding barrel housing details: sleeve box, tori rings, sight camera, plus two small side water pipes. I'm also planning roof antennas with glowing tips, speaker horn cones on the cab corners, a slatted front grille, door stencil text "RSU-07" on an SVG decal with a yellow chevron, and verifying total vehicle height comes out around 2.9 units with wheels sitting flush on the ground.

Setting up imports for glow and metal materials, defining a panelled paint texture for the tank and roof, and writing a decal helper function for placing textured planes on the body. Now I'm sketching a compact hexagonal logo SVG.

Adding a dark panel background for legibility, then sketching a glass-effect SVG with gradients and HUD lines, and starting a procedural hull paint function with smoothstep falloffs...

Still writing hull shader logic...
